method: Independent read-only source review, not an executed browser/API/transaction test.

checks.name: Inference authority
checks.evidence: ML controller receives a simulator snapshot; advisor changes newly created copied engines. It cannot approve, execute or persist an action.

checks.name: As-of knowledge
checks.evidence: Future road schedules rejected for operator ranking. Candidate feature input uses observedClone with replay/command/private initial settings stripped. Temporal operator ranking explicitly uses no past history and warns about this difference.

checks.name: Operator approvals
checks.evidence: Candidate exact equality/fingerprint and paused non-replay state checked on request; explicit operator identifier checked on approve; same-state candidate revalidation and unconsumed approval checked before transactional execution.

checks.name: Score interpretation
checks.evidence: Shared fixed B5 score used only to rank existing Continue/Wait/Reroute actions; separate five-action isolated benchmark, associative predictions, missing delivery targets and short temporal context explicitly identified.

checks.name: Domain warnings
checks.evidence: Original provider warnings were nested only inside raw offers. Advisor now propagates/deduplicates provider warnings, and frontend renders Advice.warnings in visible paragraphs outside raw JSON details.

limitations: Source review does not prove runtime correctness, transactional behavior or browser rendering; use separately executed integration/browser tests.
Frontend run/clock eligibility is a convenience check; exact fingerprint authority stays on backend.
Live operator candidates retain their original deterministic source/version for existing approval validation; this is not the same policy repertoire as isolated B5 evaluation.
